Question: When does Elena get together with Damon in The Vampire Diaries?
Answer: The answer to this question wouldn’t be justified by just mentioning the episode name or something like that. The answer to this question requires a bit of explanation. This is a very complex question which has been asked over and over again. Everywhere. Many people just don't seem to grasp Elena's swing towards Damon - especially when she was already in a relationship with Stefan. She did not get together with Damon in a straight line. It took years to build-up her feelings for him. Till the point, she dumped Stefan and immediately caught up with Damon. Well, please allow me to explain those little steps she took, even though unknowingly, which took her closer to Damon. Remember in season 1 when Damon was in full swing mode to open the tomb that he thought Katherine was in? He loved Katherine for more than 145 years. He waited for her all those years. At first, Elena and Stefan cheated him, by tricking him to believe that they were helping him in opening the tomb. But in the second attempt, Elena removed her vervain necklace and talked with Damon so that he would trust her. He could have compelled her at that time, but he didn't. That was the very first event where she developed a little softer side towards him. Even though she didn't realize that at that time. Elena’s nature was very different from other girls. She saw the good in people. She had sympathy for people too. She never abandoned the people whom she cared about. She was even willing to sacrifice herself for the people she cared about. She almost did that a few times. I believe somewhere deep down in her heart, she had sympathy for Damon - because his love for Katherine was very strong (she could empathize with that), and also because he was Stefan’s brother. Well, as the story moves on, Damon found that Katherine wasn’t inside the tomb. He was very hurt because of this. Elena could feel what he was going through. She came towards him to share his pain. She also hugged him to ease his pain from Katherine’s betrayal (or sort of betrayal) and to show that she cared about him. Afterwards, when Stefan was taken away by the tomb vampires, she accompanied Damon into saving him along with Alaric. She didn’t know at the time, but slowly her softness towards Damon was beginning to take deeper roots in her heart. And remember the beauty contest episode? Elena had been rehearsing her dance steps with Stefan, but he didn’t show up at the event. Then Damon, without any previous plans or practice, stepped up and became her partner in the dance scene. I’d like to think that he did much, much better job - in dancing with her with perfect positioning and steps. Also, he saved her from the embarrassment in front of the whole crowd because her original dance partner Stefan didn’t show up at the event. This is where she began to like him much more. Everything was slowly developing until Katherine showed up and broke his heart. Again. In the same episode, Elena broke his heart too. There's so much pain a man can take. Then, he spiralled and snapped Elena's brother’s neck (but he was wearing the Gilbert ring, so he came back). Afterwards, he was honest when she asked him whether he knew about the ring. Afterwards, the episode where Elena, Damon and Alaric went to meet Isobel’s intern, he took an arrow behind his back to save Elena. See, these little or big things Damon did for her, kept magnifying her feelings for him. After that, in one episode, Isobel tells her that Damon is in love with her. Remember? The whole of season 2 showed Damon’s attempts to save Elena. He also once told Stefan that he would let her hate him, but he would be the one keeping her alive. The vervain necklace (which was a symbol of her and Stefan's love) played an important role too. After she was kidnapped by Rose, Damon found it and gave it back to her. Selflessly. After that, the much of the season 3 revolved around Damon helping Elena get Stefan back. But Stefan did some weird things (crazy Stefan) that pushed her away from him and slowly closer to Damon. Also, we again saw that the vervain necklace had a key role to play. Damon gave it back to her on her birthday. Again. In season 4, after she transitioned into a vampire, her feelings for Damon were magnified to a much larger scale. He also fished her daylight ring out and returned it to her. That, after he saved her. Again. Her feelings for Damon had become so strong that she broke up with Stefan and immediately went into Damon’s arms. She was sired to Damon, yes, but still, her feelings for him were much stronger than anything she had ever felt in her life. And at the end of the season, Elena (without being sired) confessed her love to Damon. And from there, they never looked back. That is when they got together. In season 5, we saw a few breakups and similar stuff, but they were never really separated from each other. They were always together. Damon even told her, “Being with you drives me nuts. Not being with you drives me nuts." Thank you for reading this answer. I wrote down what I felt from my perspective. It became a bit lengthy answer, but I believe this topic needed this kind of explanation. Thank you. Image credit: The CW Network.
